retrievalProfile.description: A rustic, earth-toned composition featuring a group of figures in period-accurate workwear standing before a weathered wooden structure, topped with bold, outlined slab-serif typography.
triggerTerms: rustic americana photography with slab serif
weathered wooden cabin background with blue outlined text

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-contrast, warm-toned photograph of four men in 19th-century style work clothes (vests, suspenders, hats) holding tools like shovels and rifles, positioned in front of a wooden shack and a wagon. The image is crowned by heavy, blue-filled slab-serif display type with white outlines.
coreVisualRelationships: Text anchored to the top third of the frame against a dark foliage background
Figures centered horizontally in the mid-ground
Vertical lines of the cabin and tools contrasting with the horizontal lines of the roof and wagon
Warm brown and green environment contrasting with cool blue typography
coreInvariants: Heavy slab-serif typography with high-contrast outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures occupy the center mid-ground at a medium-long shot scale, integrated with a wooden cabin and wagon.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, blue slab-serif title at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large blue text, move down to the figures, and then scan the rustic textures of the cabin and grass.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky area is filled with dark green foliage, providing a high-contrast backdrop for the title text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earth tones (browns, tans, and olive greens) in the photograph.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue used for the primary display text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White outlines on text and highlights on the figures' shirts.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a warm, slightly yellow-tinted value, characteristic of vintage film stock.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure blacks; use deep browns or dark greens instead.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with blocky terminals and thick strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and D characters have very small internal counters relative to their stroke weight.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic slab-serif family using weight and color to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin white border around the main title
Small logo emblem in the bottom left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif weight and blocky terminals.
Provides the geometric slab-serif look common in mid-century design.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage-style photograph of four men in 19th-century rural workwear standing in front of a weathered wooden cabin and a wooden-wheeled wagon. The lighting should be warm and sun-drenched, with a dark green leafy canopy at the top of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered, uppercase slab-serif text at the top. The primary title should be blue with a white outline. Smaller white slab-serif text should be placed directly underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the typography a heavy slab-serif?
Is the color palette dominated by warm earth tones and blue accents?
Does the image look like a vintage film photograph?
Are the figures wearing period-appropriate clothing?

adjustableVariables: Shade of blue for the text

mustAchieve: Consistent vintage film grain and color grading

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue text has a distinct white outline.
Check that the cabin texture looks like aged, unpainted wood.
Verify the figures are integrated into the scene naturally.
Confirm the overall composition feels like a square album cover.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Americana + Heavy Slab Serif + Weathered Wood Texture
